entity: The ELMCIP Electronic Literature Knowledge Base (elmcip.net): in its own words a research resource for electronic literature, now preserved as a frozen archive (June 2010 – October 2026), developed in Drupal 7 by the University of Bergen Electronic Literature Research Group as an outcome of the ELMCIP project (Electronic Literature as a Model of Creativity and Innovation in Practice, a HERA-funded collaborative research project, 2010–2013); 17,073 published records at its freeze; its mission stated to live on through the Digital Narrative Knowledge Base; formalized in the traininglayerliterature.org layer census record of 2026-11-01 (https://www.traininglayerliterature.org/aggregators/elmcip)
row_type: C (a public entity on which the archive bears: a frozen, contributory knowledge base of electronic literature; an entity of the traininglayerliterature.org layer census, host_relation 'historical lineage')

aliases.pattern: \bElectronic Literature as a Model of Creativity\b

classes_note: Five classes, each sourced by the field B and the layer census record. (0) electronic literature as the field the knowledge base documents: B1, B2, B3; TLL area field-history and record_object. (1) databases and indexes of electronic literature: B1, B2, B3, B4; TLL areas field-history, evidence_kind, record_type. (2) the procedural lineage, generators and combinatory works, which the knowledge base records: B1's records, B3; TLL record_object and tll_reading. (3) the end state of a research infrastructure (freezing, precarity, migration, succession): B1, B3, B5; TLL lifecycle, negative_tags. (4) contributory, collectively authored records of a field: B1, B2, B3; TLL method and record.name. The census's anchors are read at their passages whatever the string pass returns: #186 (the procedural lineage, the four columns, the three criteria of address, architecture and persistence) and #1543 (machine composition: the composition/provenance distinction). 'ELMCIP' matches the project and the knowledge base; a sentence naming the project only is read for what it says of the knowledge base.
